Description: Mimir API key for authenticating with the Mimir MAM platform. Format: sakm.<identifier>.<secret>
Saga API key for authenticating with the Saga editorial platform.

REQUIRED. Base URL for the Saga REST API (an API Gateway invoke URL in the form https://<id>.execute-api.<region>.amazonaws.com/v1). This is NOT the Mimir web URL (https://<instance>.mjoll.no) — Saga and Mimir are separate services at separate endpoints.
Mimir instance region identifier. Used to construct the Mimir API base URL (https://<instance>.mjoll.no).
Mimir metadata field name where the AI-generated summary is written. Must be a valid field in the tenant's MDF. Common values: 'description', 'summary', 'ai_summary'.

Optional. Pin the Cognito issuer URL allowed to invoke custom actions (e.g. https://cognito-idp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/us-east-1_XXXXXXXXX). Leave blank to accept any valid AWS Cognito issuer — tokens must still be signature-valid, unexpired Cognito ID tokens. Set this to lock the API to your specific Mimir tenant.

When 'true', the Summarize action runs AWS Transcribe on items that have no Mimir transcript, publishes the transcript back to Mimir, and includes it in the summary. Set to 'false' to keep summaries visual-only and avoid Transcribe costs.

Base name of the Reframe + Graphics Lottie templates in the templates bucket: templates/<prefix>-1080x1920-9x16.json, -1080x1080-1x1.json and -1080x1350-4x5.json. Default 'graphics-overlay' is the reference template that every deploy uploads from graphics/templates/. For a customer template use its own name (e.g. 'sinclair-demo') so the deploy never overwrites it. Letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' only; no '/' or '..'.

When 'true', the deploy registers the Mimir 'Embed Video Content' webhook so new video items are embedded automatically. Set to 'false' to register no embeddings webhook (an existing one is removed on deploy).

Optional. Mimir metadata fieldId (from the metadata form definition, not the UI label), e.g. 'Station' for Sinclair, that decides which video items get embeddings. The Mimir webhook condition uses this id. Leave blank, together with EmbeddingsFilterValues, to embed every video item. Set both or neither.

Optional. Comma-separated values of EmbeddingsFilterField to embed, e.g. 'WKEF' or 'WKEF,WBFF'. Exact, case-sensitive match on the stored field value (not the display label; for Sinclair's Station they are the same). One Mimir webhook is registered per value.

Optional, usually blank. Explicit metadata.formData key (e.g. the field UUID) for the pipeline's defensive filter check. Blank = the pipeline tries formData[field], formData['default_' + field], then the field UUID looked up in the Mimir metadata forms, and lets the item through if the field cannot be resolved.
